Kanaram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:44277) on 18
December, 2023

Bench: Dinesh Mehta [2023:RJ-JD:44277] HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR S.B.
Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 15298/2023 Kanaram S/o Shri Dungarram, Aged About 20 Years, R/o Lapunda Sutharo Ki Dhani, Tehsil And Dist. Barmer, Raj.
----Petitioner Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP 2.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Dharmveer Jhakad S/o Shri Pramaram, R/o Bhopalgarh, Dist. Jodhpur At Present Ms. Rajasthan Coting And Chemical, F-237, 3 Phase, Boranada, Jodhpur
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Kistur Chand For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, PP Mr. Abhinav Jain JUSTICE DINESH MEHTA Order 18/12/2023 1.

This application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (hereinafter referred to as 'Cr.P.C.') has been filed by the applicant apprehending his arrest in connection with FIR No.352/2023, registered at Police Station Boranada, District Jodhpur City (West) for the offences under Sections 420, 406 and 379 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred to as 'IPC').

entities.text: Police Station Boranada, District Jodhpur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the FIR has been lodged after about 45 days of the alleged incident.

It was also argued that on the basis of the allegation leveled against the applicant, no offences under Sections 420, 406 and 379 of the IPC are made out and the custodial interrogation/investigation of the applicant is not required as no recovery is to be made from him.

[2023:RJ-JD:44277] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-15298/2023]
3. Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application.

4. Mr. Jain, learned counsel for the complainant while opposing the bail application with full vehemence argued that there is an evidence in the form of C.C.T.V. footage, which clearly shows that the applicant has intentionally taken out 5 samples out of 3 compartments only and he has not taken any sample from the remaining two compartments in order to cloak or shield the act of mixing the water that he had committed by taking out the chemicals from the alleged two compartments.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the applicant and considering that no recovery remains to be made and veracity of the evidence (if any) in the form of C.C.T.V. footage can very well be examined Kanaram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:44277) on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99843030/
1 by the trial Court during the course of trial, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

6. Accordingly, the bail application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant - Kanaram S/o Shri Dungarram in connection with FIR No.352/2023, registered at Police Station Boranada, District Jodhpur City (West), the applicant shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
alongwith two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer/SHO on the following conditions:-
(1) that the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation before a police officer as and when required;
[2023:RJ-JD:44277] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-15298/2023] (2) that the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any Police Officer; and (3)
that the applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
(DINESH MEHTA),J 226-akansha/-
